summary: Secondary Shawnee National Forest lookout in Hardin County, Illinois: a 40-foot pole tower dated c.1938. Name uncertain; no present status found.

facts.design: 40-foot pole with ladder and crow's nest

events.note: Approximate. The page dates the pole to c.1938 and says it was erected as a secondary lookout site.

notes_for_editor: One page describes this tower (Central US Lookouts). It gives a c.1938 date, a 40-foot pole with ladder and crow's nest, and the county, but no status, staffing or access. The name is uncertain: the page reads Lamb (Tucker Hill?), and two web searches found no Tucker Hill or Lamb tower in Hardin County. Source 2 is used only for the four-standing-towers list; Lamb is not on it. The brief's height, county and agency agree with source 1, so no corrections are proposed.
